name: Sliding Window
summary: Keep a contiguous region under observation with two pointers: the right pointer extends it, the left pointer shrinks it. Instead of recomputing an answer for every subarray, update the answer while the window moves.
signal: contiguous substring/subarray + longest, shortest, maximum, minimum, valid window
mentalModel: RIGHT expands. LEFT shrinks. Every step is O(1), never a rescan.
recognitionRules: The problem asks about a contiguous region: substring, subarray, consecutive range.
The answer is a longest / shortest / largest / smallest such region.
A window is valid or invalid, and validity can be maintained incrementally.
You need frequency counts of the elements currently inside the window.
The naive solution restarts work for each start position.
template: add element right to the window state
remove element left from the window state
invariant: The window is valid after shrinking, and every index strictly before left has already been ruled out for this and all later right positions.
